lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Ordered matrix of high-luminance circular pixel clusters posterior to the branchial region, arranged in roughly parallel horizontal rows along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical linear features of increased pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows, creating a well-defined grid-like topology with blobs appearing at the intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges on the dorsal-lateral surface exhibit sharp vertical luminance gradients, characterized by light-reflecting superior edges and shadowed inferior margins.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A sparse distribution of small, high-luminance pixel clusters is contained within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin, with higher density visible along the anterior margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent high-luminance horizontal linear anomaly is visible on the upper flank, superior to the posterior gill slits.
other_distinctive_markers: The upper lobe of the caudal fin displays a unique constellation of high-luminance spots across its visible surface.
